{{SameName|Mother Ducky|'''D00M's Revenge''' • [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Revenge]]}}{{EventSandboxOnly|date=28th of May 2022|event=[[Duck Hunt Event]]}}{{For|other uses of [[Duck (Disambiguation)|Duck]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Mother Ducky |image1 = MOM.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 8 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]40Beyond wave 20, '''Mother Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Motherly Care}}''' - Upon spawning, spawns a [[Cart]] that follows it. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mother Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had high health for its debut and a slightly slow speed. The '''Mother Ducky''' always spawns with a [[Cart]] behind it. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Mother Ducky''' is a white duck with black eyes, white feet and an orange beak. The '''Mother Ducky''' also has a neck, unlike most other ducky enemies. It wears a grey straw hat with a pink ribbon. It has a brown wooden bowl with three [[Eggroll]]s on its back and pulled a [[Cart]] behind it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Mother Ducky'''. **Multiple [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range, letting them defeat the '''Mother Ducky''' from further away, making it easier to deal with the [[Cart]] and [[Eggroll]]s spawned. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As the '''Mother Ducky''' always has a [[Cart]] behind it, with that [[Cart]] being able to spawn multiple [[Eggroll]]s, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], are recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRMotherDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Mother Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHuntPI.png|'''Mother Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Mother Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyMotherDuckyIconIG.png|'''Mother Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mother Ducky''' and the [[Cart]] were two separate enemies when spawning, though when '''Mother Ducky''' was still alive, the [[Cart]]'s movement was locked to be behind it. **Due to the [[Cart]]'s lower health, it was possible to kill the [[Cart]] before '''Mother Ducky''', such as through the use of splash damage towers. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Mother Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Mother Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] ** '''Mother Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Ducky]]|Wave 7|Mother Ducky|Wave 8|[[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Mother Ducky}}
